light.basis: Actual local prompt.html UI in Chromium; built-in image_gen

face_rationale: Blue carapace and large angular spike inform broad square jaw and angled brows; the wide flat wings inform long windswept hair. A short nose and almond eyes distinguish this adult from the long narrow-eyed battery form.
final_face_line: FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): angular face, balanced length, medium width; square broad jaw; almond eyes, medium size, level outer corners, average spacing; angled brows; short nose with upturned tip; thin lips.
original_policy: PNG session-only; only hashes and WebP published
